description: This file declares interfaces related to a reftable system, including functions for initializing iterators and blocks, as well as referencing table metadata.

methods.name: reftable_table_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the reftable.

methods.name: table_init_iter
methods.description: Initializes a reftable iterator for the given table and type.

methods.name: table_init_block
methods.description: Initializes a reftable block by reading from the table at a specified offset and type.
